proposal.reason: Main functional change is CU/CE dispatch policy handling: strategy state is moved to a process-wide cache keyed by (device, kernel) and shared by native/user dispatch paths, with applied-state tracking and launchConfig returned from the cached applied entry to avoid stale per-FUNC_INDEX/per-comm skip decisions. Changes in enqueue/comm/init are supporting call-site and lifecycle plumbing for this dispatch behavior, not separate module-owned policy changes.
